items.name: Rain
items.description:
The calming sound of mother nature

Concept LoRA to enhance rain. Pony understand well what rain is but sometimes gets a little bit confused with rain under roofs, clothes that are not wet enough and atmosphere is too bright when there are dark clouds.

Model helps with wet surfaces, wet clothing, wet hair and general composition.

Weirdly enough, model also helps with showering scenes

If you are planning to hide character from rain, you can add wet clothes / wet hair into negatives to prevent characters from being wet.

Added Illustrious version to enhance rain.

Lora weight : 0.8-1

Main trigger :

  • heavy-rain

  • rain

  • wet (affects skin wetness too)

  • cloudy

Secondary triggers :

  • wet clothes

  • wet hair

  • water drops

  • dark

  • storm

  • dark atmosphere

  • blurry background

  • umbrella

  • holding umbrella

  • see-through (for any nsfw stuff you might want to do and to boost wetness)

  • showering

  • under shower

If you have any requests feel free to message me here or on discord, I will see what I can do!

If you enjoy my work and you would like to support me, how about a coffee?

This is a requested character. Reminder that the request form is closed.

Weight: 1.0

The results of your generations are dependent on the additional LoRAs, weights, and models you use, so it may not work or come out as consistent as my sample images. Other reasons may include me using xformers, token merging, and a modified DPM++ 2M Karras sampler. You'll also notice that my prompt includes <lyco:. Note that all my LoRA files are located within my LyCORIS folder. If the model is labeled as a LoRA, it's a simple LoRA. If it's specified as a LyCORIS, it's a LoHa.

items.name: Rainbow Morph - bring sunglasses (Krea-2, ZiT, Flux, XL, and Pony)
items.description:
Rainb0w_M0rph:
Rainb0w_M0rph for Krea-2. Lower strengths are fine for detailed prompts making use of the trigger phrase of Rainb0w_M0rph. Higher strengths give a stronger effect, and will be liberally applied with light use of the trigger phrase.

ZiT V1.0:
Rainb0w_M0rph for ZiT. I've found best results by giving a brief description(eg, photo of a Rainb0w_M0rph cat), followed by a more detailed description of the scene you want(the cat has Rainb0w_M0rph fur, it's singing, and farting Rainb0w_M0rph as it flies through space).

Flux V1.0:
Rainb0w M0rph for Flux 1 Dev- my first foray into Flux loras, so let's see how this goes!

I'm noticing that when it works it works really well(IMHO!), and when it doesn't work, its just a good, but non-rainbow, image - putting the strength up does fix that without impacting the quality. I found up between 1 and 1.75 works just fine. Higher strengths work fine as well, but I wouldn't recommend going above 2.


XL V1.0:
This lora adds colour to the world, by adding rainbows wherever you want them. "Rainb0w M0rph" is the main trigger, but focus it by adding "rainb0w"(e.g., rainb0w cat, rainb0w skin) to any particular item that to want to pop!

It really doesn't like colourful ears on people, so play with the prompting if you have someone that forgot to paint their ears.

Trained on base SD XL.
Doesn't seem to have any affect on Pony models, but YMMV, of course.


Pony V1.0
Pony version! This one can be much brighter, but will also sometimes struggle to colour landscapes, particularly under low weights. It does well at human made objects, can do nice trees and plants, and of course, it can make colourful people and animals(and inbetweens) too.

The trigger is the same as for the XL version, "Rainb0w M0rph". If you have a particular area that you want to colour rainbow-style, you can also use "Rainb0w ...", where ... is whatever you want to focus on, such as "Rainb0w cat", or "Rainb0w hat".

If you find that your you Rainb0w cat is looking a bit dull, or is bright, but only in one or two colours, then try adding prompts such as "Rainb0w fur" or "Rainb0w tail", to give it a colourful kick up the posterior!

I recommend a strength of 1 to 1.25, generally. Any higher gets messy, 0.5 and below doesn't have much impact at all. I found it works pretty well with the original Pony; it has good effects on other Pony models too, including those aimed for realism, although more prompting tends to be required to get a full rainb0w skin there.

items.name: Rainswept Ruins: Portraits of a Tarnished Youth
items.description:
The monochromatic black-and-white style is often adopted in art and design because it provides a powerful visual impact for viewers, emphasizing content and form.

My model primarily trained on two segments of content. The first segment focuses on lighting and shadow in a monochrome style. The second integrates the monochromatic lighting and shadow with the following elements: rain, water, abandoned cities, forests, and a girl in a jacket

Anyone can give this model a try!

If you don't want such a somber effect in your images but still want to try the monochromatic style, you can still give my model a shot. It offers an incredible contrast in lighting and shading. You can try reducing the weight when using it; this will yield a much better monochromatic result than simply entering trigger words.

这是一个单色风格的阴间模型，喜欢的可以试试。。。

items.description:
機動武闘伝Gガンダムの、レイン・ミカムラのキャラクターLoRAのPONY版です。

学習画像のほとんどをファイティングスーツ姿で構成したので、基本的にはその姿で生成されるはずです。

衣装の再現性は、個人的にかなり高い印象ですが、100％完全再現を目指すとなると、流石にそれは厳しいですので、その辺りを考慮して、お使い下さいませ。

PixAIの、XLPONYモデルにて作成しております。

google translation↓

This is the PONY version of Rain Mikamura's character LoRA from Mobile Fighter G Gundam.

Most of the training images were composed of her in a fighting suit, so basically they should be generated in that form.

Personally, I feel that the reproducibility of the costumes is quite high, but if you are aiming for 100% perfect reproduction, it would be difficult to do so, so please take this into consideration when using it.

Created using PixAI's XLPONY model.
